title: Placed machine configuration
statement: Given a placement of $k$ work tapes into $l$ work tapes, a state map from $S$ to $H$, $l$ tape-content functions and head positions, and a configuration of a $k$-tape Boolean machine on input $x$, the placed configuration is obtained by embedding that configuration into the $l$-tape arrangement and renaming its state by the given map.
caveat: The snippet does not define the embedded-configuration operation, so the exact arrangement of tape contents and head positions is not specified by the supplied text.
